 Calgary area stands in for New York and Montana – in the same new movie!
 Locations include High River, University of Calgary and Stephen Avenue subbing in for Montana and New York City.
 Author of the article: By Eric Volmers Published Nov 17, 2026 Last updated 14 hours ago 2 minute read Join the conversation Jared Padalecki and Andie MacDowell in a scene from the Alberta-shot romantic comedy Guarding Stars, which debuts Nov. 18 on Netflix. Courtesy, Netflix. Courtesy of Netflix Article content One thing’s for certain when it comes to making a movie in the Calgary area: This part of the world is extremely versatile!

The new Christmas romantic comedy featuring Supernatural and Gilmore Girls star Jared Padalecki and Gossip Girl’s Leighton Meester, which starts streaming on Netflix Nov. 18.

 Article content In the movie, Stephen Avenue and other parts of our downtown stand in for New York City. The production also used parts of the University of Calgary campus, including t he Hunter Student Commons and the Faculty of Nursing Clinical Simulation Learning Centre. That’s where scenes involving a boardroom meeting and a hospital emergency room were shot.

 Article content “Big city, small town, mountains, prairie — the Calgary region can play almost any part,” Calgary Economic Development said in a social media post Wednesday. “And behind every production are real careers for actors, writers, camera operators, set designers, crews and more.” 
 Article content Guarding Stars was filmed in these various locations last December.
 Article content Based on Katherine Center’s bestselling novel, The Bodyguard, the film focuses on the relationship between Padalecki’s Jack Stapleton, a Hollywood action star, and his bodyguard Hannah Brooks, played by Meester. The two pose as a couple on a Montana ranch after Jack is threatened by a stalker. Real romantic sparks will presumably fly at some point. Directed by Allen Rosenbaum, the film also stars Golden Globe winner Andie MacDowell, known for Four Weddings and a Funeral, Short Cuts and Sex, Lies and Videotapes; and Noah LaLond, best known for playing Cole Walter in the Alberta-shot Netflix series My Life with the Walter Boys.

Article content Guarding Stars and My Life With the Walter Boys are just two of the projects Netflix has brought to the province. Two seasons of the 2018 zombie series Black Summe r weres filmed in Calgary and surrounding areas. The western The Abandons ,  the Korean romantic comedy series Can This Love Be Translated?, parts of the docuseries Our Living World and the upcoming limited true-crime series The Murder of JonBenet Ramsey, starring Clive Owen and Melissa McCarthy, were filmed in the province. The Murder of JonBenet Ramsey airs Dec. 10 on Netflix.
 Article content In 2024, film workers from IATSE 212 signed a three-year deal with the streaming giant to pave the way for more production in the province. It was the first union in Canada to sign such a deal with Netflix.
